# StarLayer API Overview (generated)

## `starlayer`

- **[`StarLayerDataset`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset)** (class) - The whole store. ``default_union`` (default True) makes ``triples`` / ``len`` / ``iter`` / SPARQL's default graph the union of all graphs, as the engine's graph view does; False restricts them to the default graph (rdflib's ``Dataset``).
- **[`StarLayerDataset.clear`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-clear)** (method) - _(no docstring)_
- **[`StarLayerDataset.copy`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-copy)** (method) - _(no docstring)_
- **[`StarLayerDataset.default_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-default_graph)** (method) - A view of the dataset's default graph (re-made on each access; it shares this dataset's ``prefixes``).
- **[`StarLayerDataset.default_union`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-default_union)** (method) - _(no docstring)_
- **[`StarLayerDataset.from_rdflib`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-from_rdflib)** (method) - A new in-memory ``StarLayerDataset`` from an rdflib ``Dataset`` / ``ConjunctiveGraph`` / ``StarLayerDataset`` (every graph, empty named graphs too, prefixes, ``default_union``) or from a plain graph (its triples go to the default graph). Terms as in ``StarLayerGraph.from_rdflib``. An ``StarLayerDataset`` is copied.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-graph)** (method) - A view of one graph (created, empty, if it does not exist yet); shares this dataset's ``prefixes`` dict.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.graph_names`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-graph_names)** (method) - _(no docstring)_
- **[`StarLayerDataset.graphs`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-graphs)** (method) - The default graph, then every named graph (empty ones included).
- **[`StarLayerDataset.has_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-has_graph)** (method) - _(no docstring)_
- **[`StarLayerDataset.quads`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-quads)** (method) - Quads matching ``(s, p, o[, graph])``; graph ``None`` is any graph (the default graph included).
- **[`StarLayerDataset.reifications`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-reifications)** (method) - A dataset of the ``rdf:reifies`` triples of every reified triple term matching ``s p o``, per graph.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.reified_triples`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-reified_triples)** (method) - A dataset of the ``reifier rdf:reifies <triple term>`` triples of ``reifier``, per graph.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.reifier_annotations`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-reifier_annotations)** (method) - A dataset of the annotation triples ``(reifier, predicate, value)`` of every reifier of ``TT``, per graph.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.reifiers`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-reifiers)** (method) - A dataset of every matching reifier's triples (its ``rdf:reifies`` links and annotations), each kept in the graph it came from. ``list(reification.reifiers(ds))`` gives the reifier nodes alone.
- **[`StarLayerDataset.remove`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-remove)** (method) - _(no docstring)_
- **[`StarLayerDataset.remove_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-remove_graph)** (method) - Remove a named graph with its triples (the default graph is emptied).
- **[`StarLayerDataset.to_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerDataset-to_graph)** (method) - Every triple of every graph merged into one new in-memory ``StarLayerGraph`` (provenance by graph is lost; equal triples collapse). It is a copy: it can be queried or compared on its own.
- **[`StarLayerGraph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerGraph)** (class) - One graph of a store: the default graph (``identifier=None``) or the named graph ``identifier`` (a ``NamedNode``, ``BlankNode``, or an IRI string).
- **[`StarLayerGraph.clear`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerGraph-clear)** (method) - _(no docstring)_
- **[`StarLayerGraph.copy`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerGraph-copy)** (method) - An independent in-memory copy of this graph (same identifier, own copy of the prefixes). ``copy.copy`` and ``copy.deepcopy`` do the same, also for a graph opened with ``path=``.
- **[`StarLayerGraph.from_rdflib`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerGraph-from_rdflib)** (method) - A new in-memory ``StarLayerGraph`` with the triples, prefixes and (when it is an IRI) identifier of an rdflib ``Graph`` or an old-style ``StarLayerGraph``; a ``TripleTerm`` becomes a triple term, a directional literal in its datatype-IRI form (what ``to_rdflib`` writes) is restored, and the basic encoding is left as triples (``interop.from_basic`` decodes it). A term RDF does not allow raises ``TermError`` (``term_policy("lenient")`` stores a stand-in). An ``StarLayerGraph`` is copied. For an rdflib dataset's named graphs use ``StarLayerDataset.from_rdflib``.
- **[`StarLayerGraph.identifier`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-core-StarLayerGraph-identifier)** (method) - _(no docstring)_
- **[`StarShaclSchema`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema)** (class) - A shapes graph (and optionally an ontology graph, a default data graph, a scoring graph and an entailment regime), bound once, to validate, run rules against, or evaluate node expressions over any number of data graphs.
- **[`StarShaclSchema.apply_rules`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-apply_rules)** (method) - Runs the rules of the bound shapes graph over ``data_graph`` (default: the bound one); see :func:`apply_rules`. ``shapes_graph_resource`` selects a named ``sh:ShapesGraph`` module of the bound shapes graph.
- **[`StarShaclSchema.close_shape`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-close_shape)** (method) - The bound shapes graph reduced to ``shape`` and every shape it references (directly or through ``sh:property``, ``sh:node``, ``sh:and``/``sh:or``/``sh:xone``/``sh:not``, ``sh:qualifiedValueShape`` ...): a self-contained shapes graph.
- **[`StarShaclSchema.data_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-data_graph)** (method) - The default data graph, as an Oxigraph-backed graph (``StarLayerGraph`` / ``StarLayerDataset``).
- **[`StarShaclSchema.evaluate`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-evaluate)** (method) - Computes the ``sh:values`` / ``sh:defaultValue`` virtual properties of the bound shapes graph over ``data_graph`` (default: the bound one); see :func:`evaluate`.
- **[`StarShaclSchema.extract_shapes_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-extract_shapes_graph)** (method) - Extracts the ``sh:ShapesGraph`` named ``shapes_graph_iri`` as a standalone graph (its members, with their blank-node closures and the declared prefixes), or ``None`` when the bound shapes graph has no such resource.
- **[`StarShaclSchema.ont_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-ont_graph)** (method) - The ontology graph, as an Oxigraph-backed graph (``StarLayerGraph`` / ``StarLayerDataset``).
- **[`StarShaclSchema.scoring_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-scoring_graph)** (method) - The scoring graph of ``shui:WidgetScore`` entries, as an Oxigraph-backed graph (``StarLayerGraph`` / ``StarLayerDataset``).
- **[`StarShaclSchema.select_widgets`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-select_widgets)** (method) - Chooses a SHACL 1.2 UI widget for each property of the node shape ``shape_node``, using the bound shapes graph.
- **[`StarShaclSchema.shacl_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-shacl_graph)** (method) - The shapes graph, as an Oxigraph-backed graph (``StarLayerGraph`` / ``StarLayerDataset``).
- **[`StarShaclSchema.target_nodes`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-target_nodes)** (method) - The nodes ``shape_node`` targets in ``data_graph`` (default: the bound one), as ``validate()`` resolves them.
- **[`StarShaclSchema.validate`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-validate)** (method) - Validates ``data_graph`` (default: the bound data graph) against the bound shapes graph; see :func:`validate`.
- **[`StarShaclSchema.validate_each`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-StarShaclSchema-validate_each)** (method) - Validates each graph of ``data_graphs`` (default: just the bound data graph) with :meth:`validate`; the shapes are parsed once for the whole batch. Returns ``{index: ValidationResult}``.

## `starlayer.graph`

- **[`CanonicalizationComplexityError`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-rdfc_native-CanonicalizationComplexityError)** (class) - The dataset has a highly symmetric blank-node structure that RDFC-1.0 would take exponential time on (RDFC-1.0 section 7.1, "Dataset Poisoning": implementations MUST terminate early with an exception).
- **[`DirLangString`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-model-dirlangstring-DirLangString)** (class) - An RDF 1.2 directional language-tagged string literal.
- **[`DirLangString.n3`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-model-dirlangstring-DirLangString-n3)** (method) - Returns the N3/Turtle-1.2 (``"text"@lang--dir``) text form.
- **[`TripleTerm`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-model-triple-TripleTerm)** (class) - An RDF 1.2 triple term — a triple used as a resource.
- **[`TripleTerm.n3`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-model-triple-TripleTerm-n3)** (method) - Returns the N3/Turtle-1.2 (``<<( s p o )>>``) text form.
- **[`Turtle12SyntaxError`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-parsers-errors-Turtle12SyntaxError)** (class) - Malformed Turtle 1.2 input that the parser cannot recognize as any valid token or statement form.
- **[`can_resolve_import`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-oxgraph-helpers-imports-can_resolve_import)** (function) - Whether ``loader(iri)`` returns a graph (it is called once; there is no cheaper way to ask).
- **[`isomorphic`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-compare-isomorphic)** (function) - True if the two graphs or datasets (``StarLayerGraph``, ``StarLayerDataset``, ``pyoxigraph.Store``, or rdflib ``Graph`` / ``Dataset``) are equal up to blank-node relabelling: equal canonical N-Quads (RDFC-1.0). Datasets are compared as datasets, graph names included; a dataset against a plain graph compares the dataset's quads with the graph's triples in the default graph.
- **[`rdfc10_hash`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-rdfc-rdfc10_hash)** (function) - The hex digest of ``graph``'s canonical N-Quads text, stable under blank-node relabelling.
- **[`to_canonical_nquads`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-graph-rdfc-to_canonical_nquads)** (function) - The canonical N-Quads text of ``graph`` (RDFC-1.0 section 4.4.3 step 7): blank nodes labelled ``c14n0``, ``c14n1``, ..., lines sorted. ``hash_algorithm`` is ``"sha256"`` or ``"sha384"`` (the two the specification names); it also drives the canonical labelling.

## `starlayer.shacl`

- **[`EvaluationFailure`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl_engine-expressions-EvaluationFailure)** (class) - A node expression has no result for this data (Node Expressions 3.3), as opposed to an empty result.
- **[`ExecutionDiagnostics`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-results-ExecutionDiagnostics)** (class) - Counters of one validation run: the type of ``ValidationResult.diagnostics``. The engine handles RDF 1.2 triple terms natively, so the encode/decode counters stay 0 (kept so code that reads them keeps working). Not a type you'd construct directly.
- **[`MetaShaclError`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl_engine-meta-MetaShaclError)** (class) - The shapes graph does not validate against the meta-shapes; the message starts with the old preflight's text.
- **[`MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-types-MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol)** (class) - ``StarLayerGraphProtocol`` plus mutation methods - ``add()``/ ``remove()``.
- **[`MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol.add`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-types-MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol-add)** (method) - Adds ``triple`` to the graph.
- **[`MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol.remove`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-types-MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol-remove)** (method) - Removes every triple matching ``triple_pattern`` from the graph.
- **[`RuleError`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl_engine-rules-RuleError)** (class) - A rule failed, or the rules graph is ill-formed or needs something unsupported (the rule set fails as a whole).
- **[`RulesResult`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-results-RulesResult)** (class) - Result of ``apply_rules()``.
- **[`ShapeError`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl_engine-plan-ShapeError)** (class) - The shapes graph is malformed (the W3C suite's ``sht:Failure`` cases).
- **[`StarLayerGraphProtocol`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-types-StarLayerGraphProtocol)** (class) - Structural protocol every graph-like input to this package must satisfy: a bound ``namespace_manager`` plus iterability over triples.
- **[`ValidationResult`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-results-ValidationResult)** (class) - Result of ``validate()``: whether the data conforms, the validation report as a graph and as text.
- **[`apply_rules`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-apply_rules)** (function) - Executes the SHACL rules of ``shacl_graph`` against a working copy of ``data_graph``, then validates the result.
- **[`declared_conformance_profile`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-profiling-declared_conformance_profile)** (function) - A fresh copy of starlayer.shacl's self-declared SHACL 1.2 conformance statement (S3) - the starlayer.shacl resource in the library's one conformance file. Parses the bundled asset fresh on every call rather than caching - matching this project's convention elsewhere (see starontology/__init__.py::_file_graph) of never sharing one mutable graph object across callers.
- **[`derive_conforms_to`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-profiling-derive_conforms_to)** (function) - Derive ``sh:conformsTo`` triples from a validation report, per SHACL 1.2 Profiling S5.5.
- **[`evaluate`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-evaluate)** (function) - Computes the ``sh:values`` / ``sh:defaultValue`` virtual properties of ``shacl_graph`` and returns a shape-driven subgraph.
- **[`evaluate_expression`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-node_expression_api-evaluate_expression)** (function) - The nodes ``expression`` gives for ``focus`` over ``data_graph``, in order.
- **[`extract_subgraph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-subgraph_extraction-extract_subgraph)** (function) - Returns the subgraph covered by one shape+focus_node pair, or by every real entry point a whole shapes graph declares.
- **[`infer_types`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-shape_types-infer_types)** (function) - The ``rdf:type`` triples ``shapes_graph``'s structure entails and it does not already state, as an ``StarLayerGraph``.
- **[`is_inverse`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-paths-is_inverse)** (function) - Whether ``path`` is an inverse path (``[ sh:inversePath <p> ]``) at its top level. A sequence or alternative that contains one is not.
- **[`node_expression_functions`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-node_expression_api-node_expression_functions)** (function) - The SPARQL functions and operators a node expression can call (``[ sparql:concat ( ... ) ]``), as IRIs, sorted.
- **[`node_expression_operators`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-node_expression_api-node_expression_operators)** (function) - The SHACL node expression operators (``shnex:filterShape``, ``shnex:pathValues``, ``shnex:if``, ...), as IRIs, sorted.
- **[`normalize_graph_inputs`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-normalization-normalize_graph_inputs)** (function) - Normalizes a data/shapes/ontology graph, in any shape a caller may pass, to an Oxigraph-backed graph (or ``None``) via ``normalize_to_starlayer_graph()``.
- **[`normalize_to_starlayer_graph`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-normalization-normalize_to_starlayer_graph)** (function) - Normalize an input graph to an Oxigraph-backed graph (``StarLayerGraph`` / ``StarLayerDataset``).
- **[`parameter_value_shapes`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-meta_shapes-parameter_value_shapes)** (function) - Shapes that check what a shapes graph gives for the parameters of its constraint components, as an ``StarLayerGraph``.
- **[`path_values`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-paths-path_values)** (function) - The value nodes at the end of ``path``, followed from ``focus`` through ``data_graph``, as pyoxigraph terms.
- **[`select_widget`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-ui_widget_selection-select_widget)** (function) - Select the ``shui:editor``/``shui:viewer`` widget ``shape_node`` should use for ``focus_node``, per the spec's own Section 3.2 "Select Function" procedure:
- **[`select_widgets`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-ui_widget_selection-select_widgets)** (function) - Batch sibling of :func:`select_widget` - walks ``shape_node``'s own ``sh:property`` list and runs :func:`select_widget` once per property, returning ``{property_shape: widget}`` for the given ``role`` (``"editor"`` or ``"viewer"``). Every ``sh:property`` of ``shape_node`` is a key.
- **[`shapes_graph_members`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-shapes_graphs-shapes_graph_members)** (function) - The elements that belong to ``shapes_graph`` by ``rdfs:member``, ``rdfs:isDefinedBy`` or ``owl:imports`` (see the module docstring): every kind of element, not only shapes (a property group or a constraint component says ``rdfs:isDefinedBy`` too).
- **[`sparql_query_problems`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-meta_shapes-sparql_query_problems)** (function) - Each defect of an embedded query as ``(the node that holds it, sh:select/sh:ask/sh:construct, what is wrong)``: text that is not SPARQL, a query of another form than the predicate says (a SELECT in ``sh:construct``), or one that fails the SPARQL structure check (see ``check_sparql_query_text``, which raises the first). A tool shows these next to the other problems of a shapes graph.
- **[`target_nodes`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-target_nodes)** (function) - The nodes ``shape_node`` targets in ``data_graph``, in declaration order and without duplicates: the nodes ``validate()`` reports on for that shape (``sh:targetNode``, including a node expression, ``sh:targetClass`` with subclasses, ``sh:targetSubjectsOf``, ``sh:targetObjectsOf``, ``sh:targetWhere``, data-graph ``sh:shape`` and implicit class targets).
- **[`validate`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-validate)** (function) - Validates ``data_graph`` against ``shacl_graph`` per SHACL 1.2 and returns a ``ValidationResult``.
- **[`validate_each`](api-reference.generated.md#entity-starlayer-shacl-validator-validate_each)** (function) - Validates each graph of ``data_graphs`` against the same ``shacl_graph`` / ``ont_graph``; the shapes are parsed once for the whole batch. ``kwargs`` are those of :func:`validate`. Returns ``{index: ValidationResult}``.
